output.program:
domain(person,[izabella,josephine,arlo,averie]).
% Izabella sets high standards.
axiom(s1, sets_high_standards(izabella)).
% Josephine is not meticulous.
axiom(s2, not(meticulous(josephine))).
% Anyone who pushes boundaries or thinks outside the box is exceptional.
axiom(s3, rule([or(pushes_boundaries(X), thinks_outside_box(X))], exceptional(X))).
% Arlo is gifted or exceptional.
axiom(s4, or(gifted(arlo), exceptional(arlo))).
% Josephine values simplicity.
axiom(s5, values_simplicity(josephine)).
% Averie values simplicity.
axiom(s6, values_simplicity(averie)).
% If Josephine is brilliant, then she is either a perfectionist or a visionary (but not both).
axiom(s7, rule([brilliant(josephine)], xor(perfectionist(josephine), visionary(josephine)))).
% Arlo is creative.
axiom(s8, creative(arlo)).
% If Josephine is exceptional, then she is either meticulous or a visionary (but not both).
axiom(s9, rule([exceptional(josephine)], xor(meticulous(josephine), visionary(josephine)))).
% For all humans, if they are brilliant or creative (or both), then they are innovative.
axiom(s10, forall(var(x,person), implies(or(brilliant(var(x)), creative(var(x))), innovative(var(x))))).
% If Josephine either sets high standards or demands quality (but not both), then she is a perfectionist.
axiom(s11, rule([xor(sets_high_standards(josephine), demands_quality(josephine))], perfectionist(josephine))).
% Izabella is either gifted or values simplicity, but not both.
axiom(s12, xor(gifted(izabella), values_simplicity(izabella))).
% If Izabella is brilliant, then she is either a perfectionist or a visionary (but not both).
axiom(s13, rule([brilliant(izabella)], xor(perfectionist(izabella), visionary(izabella)))).
% Josephine is gifted or exceptional.
axiom(s14, or(gifted(josephine), exceptional(josephine))).
% Josephine does not demand quality.
axiom(s15, not(demands_quality(josephine))).
% Arlo is not meticulous.
axiom(s16, not(meticulous(arlo))).
% Josephine values individuality or is a visionary.
axiom(s17, or(values_individuality(josephine), visionary(josephine))).
% Josephine is highly intelligent or gifted.
axiom(s18, or(highly_intelligent(josephine), gifted(josephine))).
% Josephine is either gifted or values simplicity, but not both.
axiom(s19, xor(gifted(josephine), values_simplicity(josephine))).
% Josephine sets high standards.
axiom(s20, sets_high_standards(josephine)).
